mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_decision ( stock_code, stock_name, decision, confidence, current_price, target_price, stop_loss_price, expected_return_rate, expected_loss_rate, risk_reward_ratio, recommended_portfolio_weight, expected_holding_days, risk_level, reason, raw_response_id, decision_status, created_at ) VALUES ( #{stockCode}, #{stockName}, #{decision}, #{confidence}, #{currentPrice}, #{targetPrice}, #{stopLossPrice}, #{expectedReturnRate}, #{expectedLossRate}, #{riskRewardRatio}, #{recommendedPortfolioWeight}, #{expectedHoldingDays}, #{riskLevel}, #{reason}, #{rawResponseId}, #{decisionStatus}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, stock_code, stock_name, decision, confidence, current_price, target_price, stop_loss_price, expected_return_rate, expected_loss_rate, risk_reward_ratio, recommended_portfolio_weight, expected_holding_days, risk_level, reason, raw_response_id, decision_status, created_at FROM ai_decision WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, stock_code, stock_name, decision, confidence, current_price, target_price, stop_loss_price, expected_return_rate, expected_loss_rate, risk_reward_ratio, recommended_portfolio_weight, expected_holding_days, risk_level, reason, raw_response_id, decision_status, created_at FROM ai_decision WHERE stock_code = #{stockCode} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, stock_code, stock_name, decision, confidence, current_price, target_price, stop_loss_price, expected_return_rate, expected_loss_rate, risk_reward_ratio, recommended_portfolio_weight, expected_holding_days, risk_level, reason, raw_response_id, decision_status, created_at FROM ai_decision WHERE decision_status = #{decisionStatus} AND created_at >= CURDATE() ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT a.id, a.stock_code, a.stock_name, a.decision, a.confidence, a.current_price, a.target_price, a.stop_loss_price, a.expected_return_rate, a.expected_loss_rate, a.risk_reward_ratio, a.recommended_portfolio_weight, a.expected_holding_days, a.risk_level, a.reason, a.raw_response_id, a.decision_status, a.created_at FROM ai_decision a INNER JOIN ( SELECT stock_code, MAX(created_at) AS max_created FROM ai_decision WHERE decision_status = #{decisionStatus} AND decision = 'BUY' AND created_at >= #{since} GROUP BY stock_code ) latest ON latest.stock_code = a.stock_code AND latest.max_created = a.created_at WHERE a.decision_status = #{decisionStatus} AND a.decision = 'BUY' AND a.created_at >= #{since} ORDER BY a.created_at DESC

SELECT a.id, a.stock_code, a.stock_name, a.decision, a.confidence, a.current_price, a.target_price, a.stop_loss_price, a.expected_return_rate, a.expected_loss_rate, a.risk_reward_ratio, a.recommended_portfolio_weight, a.expected_holding_days, a.risk_level, a.reason, a.raw_response_id, a.decision_status, a.created_at FROM ai_decision a INNER JOIN ( SELECT stock_code, MAX(created_at) AS max_created FROM ai_decision WHERE decision_status = #{decisionStatus} AND decision IN ('BUY', 'SELL') AND created_at >= #{since} GROUP BY stock_code ) latest ON latest.stock_code = a.stock_code AND latest.max_created = a.created_at WHERE a.decision_status = #{decisionStatus} AND a.decision IN ('BUY', 'SELL') AND a.created_at >= #{since} ORDER BY a.created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_decision SET decision_status = 'EXPIRED' WHERE decision_status = 'CREATED' AND created_at < #{before}
mapper.select: SELECT id, stock_code, stock_name, decision, confidence, current_price, target_price, stop_loss_price, expected_return_rate, expected_loss_rate, risk_reward_ratio, recommended_portfolio_weight, expected_holding_days, risk_level, reason, raw_response_id, decision_status, created_at FROM ai_decision WHERE DATE(created_at) = CURDATE() AND decision IN ('BUY', 'SELL') ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT a.id, a.stock_code, a.stock_name, a.decision, a.confidence, a.current_price, a.target_price, a.stop_loss_price, a.expected_return_rate, a.expected_loss_rate, a.risk_reward_ratio, a.recommended_portfolio_weight, a.expected_holding_days, a.risk_level, a.reason, a.raw_response_id, a.decision_status, a.created_at FROM ai_decision a LEFT JOIN ai_feedback f ON f.ai_decision_id = a.id AND f.evaluation_type = 'HOLDING_END' WHERE a.decision IN ('BUY','SELL') AND a.expected_holding_days IS NOT NULL AND DATE_ADD(DATE(a.created_at), INTERVAL a.expected_holding_days DAY) <= #{today} AND f.id IS NULL ORDER BY a.created_at ASC

SELECT id, stock_code, stock_name, decision, confidence, current_price, target_price, stop_loss_price, expected_return_rate, expected_loss_rate, risk_reward_ratio, recommended_portfolio_weight, expected_holding_days, risk_level, reason, raw_response_id, decision_status, created_at FROM ai_decision WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to} ORDER BY created_at ASC

SELECT a.id, a.stock_code, a.stock_name, a.decision, a.confidence, a.current_price, a.target_price, a.stop_loss_price, a.expected_return_rate, a.expected_loss_rate, a.risk_reward_ratio, a.recommended_portfolio_weight, a.expected_holding_days, a.risk_level, a.reason, a.raw_response_id, a.decision_status, a.created_at FROM ai_decision a INNER JOIN order_request o ON o.ai_decision_id = a.id AND o.order_side = 'BUY' AND o.order_status IN ('ORDERED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED', 'FILLED') WHERE a.stock_code = #{stockCode} AND a.decision = 'BUY' ORDER BY o.requested_at DESC, a.created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, stock_code, stock_name, decision, confidence, current_price, target_price, stop_loss_price, expected_return_rate, expected_loss_rate, risk_reward_ratio, recommended_portfolio_weight, expected_holding_days, risk_level, reason, raw_response_id, decision_status, created_at FROM ai_decision ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT a.id AS aiDecisionId, a.stock_code AS stockCode, a.stock_name AS stockName, a.decision AS decision, a.confidence AS confidence, a.current_price AS currentPrice, a.target_price AS targetPrice, a.stop_loss_price AS stopLossPrice, a.recommended_portfolio_weight AS recommendedPortfolioWeight, a.risk_level AS riskLevel, a.decision_status AS decisionStatus, a.reason AS reason, a.created_at AS decisionCreatedAt, r.id AS riskCheckId, r.passed AS riskPassed, r.fail_reason AS riskFailReason, r.checked_at AS riskCheckedAt, o.id AS orderRequestId, o.order_side AS orderSide, o.order_status AS orderStatus, o.order_quantity AS orderQuantity, o.order_amount AS orderAmount, o.broker_type AS brokerType, o.requested_at AS orderRequestedAt FROM ai_decision a LEFT JOIN risk_check_result r ON r.id = ( SELECT rr.id FROM risk_check_result rr WHERE rr.ai_decision_id = a.id ORDER BY rr.checked_at DESC, rr.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN order_request o ON o.id = ( SELECT oo.id FROM order_request oo WHERE oo.ai_decision_id = a.id
AND oo.order_side = 'BUY' AND oo.order_status = 'FILLED'
AND oo.order_side = 'SELL' AND oo.order_status = 'FILLED'
ORDER BY oo.requested_at DESC, oo.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE a.decision IN ('BUY', 'SELL')
AND a.decision = #{filter}
AND o.id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
